profile.summary: Gnarf is a senior JavaScript developer with deep expertise in jQuery's core internals, specializing in DOM manipulation, animation systems, and cross-browser compatibility. Their contributions focus on performance optimizations, CSS property handling, and debugging legacy JavaScript codebases. The developer demonstrates strong skills in fixing IE-specific bugs, optimizing DOM traversal, and maintaining jQuery's test suite. All contributions are rooted in pre-ES6 JavaScript practices and are entirely frontend-focused, with no evidence of modern frameworks or backend work.
